Description: A city: five towers over a grid of avenues and cross streets, a three-deck parking garage, a plaza, a tunnel under Main Street, a light rail loop right round the outside with three stations, an airport with a runway, a terminal and a steel hangar, and an estate of houses with gardens and mowers. Traffic runs the roads and aircraft work the airfield. Generated by tools/gen_city.py.
